methanol.label: Methanol synthesis gas
methanol.metric_definition: SN = (H2 - CO2)/(CO + CO2) on DRY basis
methanol.source: Uhde/ThyssenKrupp Nitrogen+Syngas 2010 Table 1 (opened): methanol (H2-CO2)/(CO+CO2) ~2.0; RSC EES 2020 & Fraunhofer (opened): 2.02-2.1; Applied Sciences 2017 7,1213 (opened): make-up gas should contain 4-8 mol% CO2 for maximum activity/selectivity, S module slightly above 2; part of the imported CO2 is removed in the trim unit
methanol.status: [CONFIRMED] metric and CO2 window; CO2 trim is a design measure to enter the licensor window
methanol.drying_note: [NOT MODELLED] dryer regeneration duty; needed for the 55 C Middle East product to meet 0.5 mol% H2O

ft.label: Fischer-Tropsch (Co catalyst) synthesis gas
ft.source: Uhde/ThyssenKrupp Nitrogen+Syngas 2010 Table 1 (opened): GTL H2:CO ~2.0; OSTI 1547249 (opened PDF https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/1547249): Co 2.0-2.2, Dry 2.15
ft.status: [CONFIRMED] ratio range; 2.10 is the chosen set-point

oxo.label: Oxo / hydroformylation synthesis gas
oxo.source: Techniques de l'Ingenieur hydroformylation (opened): H2/CO = 1 to 1.25; KFUPM lecture (opened): 1-1.5; US8859823B2 (opened) 1:1 stoichiometry. V2 route changed to autothermal/partial oxidation with CO2 co-feed: an adiabatic Gibbs ATR with O2/C tuned to H2/CO = 1.05 (the pure CO2-reforming route with a pre-reformer needed CO2/C > 2.4 and produced >5 mol% CO2).
oxo.status: [CONFIRMED] ratio range; [PARTIAL] ATR route choice is a design decision

hydrogen.label: High-purity hydrogen (SMR + WGS + MDEA + PSA)
hydrogen.metric_definition: H2 mole fraction in PSA product
hydrogen.source: ISO 14687:2025 Table 3 (opened official sample PDF): H2 fuel index >=99.97%, total non-H2 <=300 umol/mol, H2O <=5, CH4 <=100, N2 <=300, CO2 <=2, CO <=0.2 umol/mol; Processes 2026 14(2),319 and Energies 2026 19(20),4873 (opened): PSA 85-90% recovery, >99% purity, MDEA 95% CO2 recovery, 2.7-3.96 GJ/tCO2 reboiler
hydrogen.status: [CONFIRMED] ISO 14687:2025 grade D limits; PSA/MDEA performance [PARTIAL] from opened open-access studies
hydrogen.PSA_slip_status: [ASSUMPTION] adsorbent selectivity weights; calibrated so the product meets ISO 14687:2025 grade D. No PSA vendor performance curve was opened; N2 is assumed to be the dominant breakthrough impurity, CH4/CO/CO2 strongly adsorbed.

ammonia.status: [CONFIRMED] flowsheet and ratio; 10 ppm target is the opened UMD/Aspen value
